text.en:
Section 1 of Executive Order No. 125 is hereby amended to read as
"SECTION 1. Devolution of Locally Funded Programs and Projects to
ARMM. - Locally funded programs and projects being undertaken and
programmed to be implemented within the ARMM are hereby devolved to and
heretofore to be implemented by the ARG of the ARMM, except:
When Congress provides in the General Appropriations Act or
special law which government agency shall implement a particular
program or project, or
When in the judgment of the ARMM Regional Governor, the ARG
does not have the capacity to implement the program and/or
project, in which case he may request a national agency to
implement the same."
POM2 Hologram • 16778

Section 8 of Executive Order No. 25 is hereby amended to read as
"SECTION 8. Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately, except for Section 1 hereof, which shall take effect starting January
1, 2003."

Section 2 of Executive Order No. 2 is hereby transferred as part of the
Whereas Clause hereof.

The Secretary of Budget and Management shall issue the necessary
rules and regulations to implement this Executive Order.
This Executive Order amends Executive Order No. 125.

Except as herein provided, this Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 2/day of November, in the year of Our
Lord, two thousand and two.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
